name: H2B clustered histone 8

function.text: H2BC8 encodes histone H2B type 1-C/E/F/G/I. Annotated molecular activities include protein heterodimerization activity and structural constituent of chromatin. It participates in chromatin organization and nucleosome assembly.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: H2BC8 encodes histone H2B type 1-C/E/F/G/I. Nucleosomes wrap and compact DNA into chromatin, limiting DNA accessibility to the cellular machineries which require DNA as a template. Histones thereby play a central role in transcription regulation, DNA repair, DNA replication and chromosomal stability. It may contribute to the formation of the functional antimicrobial barrier of the colonic epithelium, and to the bactericidal activity of amniotic fluid.
